text: Christmas Island is a small **island territory** south-southwest of Java. It is an Australian external territory, so for country streaks purposes it is counted as part of Australia.
NOTE: Do not get its location confused with the Cocos (Keeling) Islands, which are another Australian territory a little west of Christmas Island.
text_zh: 聖誕島是爪哇島南南西方的一個小型**島嶼屬地**。它是澳洲的海外屬地，因此就連續國家挑戰（Country Streaks）而言，它被算作澳洲的一部分。
註：不要將它的位置與科科斯（基林）群島搞混，那是位於聖誕島西方一點的另一個澳洲屬地。

text: Christmas Island has two types of coverage: car coverage and a couple of trekkers.
The car coverage was done with a unique Google car: a **silver pickup truck**, with the bed of the truck visible. Usually, this is all you need to identify Christmas Island.
text_zh: 聖誕島有兩種型態的覆蓋：汽車覆蓋以及幾個徒步拍攝。
汽車覆蓋是由一台獨特的 Google 車完成的：一台**銀色皮卡車**，車斗清晰可見。通常，這就是識別聖誕島所需的全部資訊。

text: Most of Christmas Island is covered by dense **tropical forest**. Some unpaved roads feature bright, white sandy soil. A small part of the coverage is in built-up areas. And in some places, [palms](https://goo.gl/maps/wzh7z1FVTpBp32RM6) can be seen.
text_zh: 聖誕島大部分地區都被茂密的**熱帶森林**覆蓋。有些未鋪裝道路帶有明亮的白色沙質土壤。一小部分覆蓋位於人口稠密區。在某些地方，可以看到[棕櫚樹](https://goo.gl/maps/wzh7z1FVTpBp32RM6)。

text: Christmas Island uses the standard **Australian bollard**. It is a simple white bollard with a red reflector on the front, and a grey reflector on the back.

NOTE: In general, road infrastructure metas are similar to those found on mainland Australia, such as [speed limit signs](https://goo.gl/maps/bMWYvWn1yBfSiWs29), [green sign backgrounds](https://goo.gl/maps/EDq64mntxxcKBnrk7), etc.
text_zh: 聖誕島使用標準的**澳洲路樁**。這是一個簡單的白色路樁，正面有紅色反光片，背面有灰色反光片。
註：一般來說，道路基礎設施的特徵與澳洲本土發現的相似，例如[速限標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/bMWYvWn1yBfSiWs29)、[綠色標誌背景](https://goo.gl/maps/EDq64mntxxcKBnrk7)等。

text: While much of the coverage is on regular roads, the Google car also drove on some very **rural trails**.
text_zh: 雖然大部分覆蓋都在一般道路上，但 Google 車也行駛在一些非常**鄉村的小徑**上。

text: The **built-up areas** are in the northeast. The rest of the island is mostly covered by dense forest.
text_zh: **人口稠密區**位於東北部。島上的其餘地區大多被茂密的森林覆蓋。

text: There is a **boat trekker** near the north coast of the island. Some of the boat’s white-coloured deck pokes through the blur. Much of the trekker closely hugs the coast; here you can see the steep, rocky coastline of Christmas Island.
text_zh: 島嶼北海岸附近有一個**船隻徒步拍攝**。該艘船白色的甲板有部分從模糊中穿透出來。該徒步拍攝大多緊貼著海岸；在這裡你可以看到聖誕島陡峭、岩石密布的海岸線。

text: There is an abundance of smaller **trail trekkers** all over the island. These are mostly surrounded by very dense foliage, but occasionally you can encounter interesting sights like [beaches](https://goo.gl/maps/MTioJbLvuheFE9ib9) and [lookouts](https://goo.gl/maps/pnpihnNe9PLUBKvT9).
NOTE: [Click here for a larger map of their locations.](/images/christmas-island/Christmas_island_trekkers_map3.png)
text_zh: 全島各處都有豐富的小型**步道徒步拍攝**。這些大多被非常濃密的樹葉包圍，但偶爾你會遇到像[海灘](https://goo.gl/maps/MTioJbLvuheFE9ib9)和[觀景台](https://goo.gl/maps/pnpihnNe9PLUBKvT9)這樣有趣的景點。
註：[點擊這裡查看其位置的較大地圖。](/images/christmas-island/Christmas_island_trekkers_map3.png)

text: An exception to the road coverage mostly having car meta is the coastal **Jln Pantai road**, where a regular trekker was used. On this road, you will not see the back of the car, just a trekker blur.
text_zh: 道路覆蓋大多擁有汽車特徵的一個例外是沿海的 **Jln Pantai 道路**，那裡使用的是一般的徒步拍攝。在這條路上，你不會看到車尾，只有徒步拍攝的模糊影像。

text: The harbour area is recognizable by the **large cranes** that are visible from many vantage points.
text_zh: 港口地區可以透過從許多觀景點都看得見的**大型起重機**來識別。

text: This **golf course trekker** is on the northeast coast. In some places, the Google car also drove on this golf course.
text_zh: 這個**高爾夫球場徒步拍攝**位於東北海岸。在某些地方，Google 車也曾開進這個高爾夫球場。

text: Christmas Island is famous for its **red crabs**. Near Ethel Beach, you can find a trekker walking among hundreds of these crabs. Another smaller trekker where you can see crabs is [near The Dales](https://goo.gl/maps/deYXgd8DDC3RfBbd6), on the West Coast. Throughout the island, you can find [references](https://goo.gl/maps/jhXdg6Yp6Yo9LpMA9) on signs to these crabs.
text_zh: 聖誕島以其**紅蟹**聞名。在埃特爾海灘（Ethel Beach）附近，你可以找到一個徒步拍攝走在數百隻這些螃蟹之中。另一個可以看到螃蟹較小的徒步拍攝位於西海岸的[戴爾斯（The Dales）附近](https://goo.gl/maps/deYXgd8DDC3RfBbd6)。在全島各處，你都可以在標誌上找到對這些螃蟹的[參考提及](https://goo.gl/maps/jhXdg6Yp6Yo9LpMA9)。
